items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: That was during the time we had one of the greatest jam sessions I've ever been on. With Charlie? Well, he was in on that session too. It was Duke Ellington, Dorothy Donegan, Art Tatum, and Jay McShann, Coleman Hawkins.

ctx.x: You mentioned Jay McShann's band. Was Charlie Parker in the band when you were in the band?

Charlie Parker rejoined the band while we was working at the Down Beat in New York. That was in 44, 45. And Mike Shan left him right there. Well, no, we didn't leave him in New York. He had to get out of town. Dave Dexter was a talent scout with Capitol Recording Company. The police was looking for Charlie then to put him in jail for dope. And they put him on a train and sent him on out to California. But he worked with us at the Down Beat in New York for about three weeks. That was during the time we had one of…
